name: Aquariums Berlin
summary: There are 4 large aquariums in Berlin: The Zoo Aquarium, Sea Life Berlin (currently closed), the Aquadom (Crash) and the Biosphere Potsdam. The app shows high-quality videos on a virtual screen, optimized for the Meta Quest and streaming transmission. Press the X, Y, A, B buttons on the controllers to load different videos. An experience for Berliners and all tourists - and now also on your Meta Quest.
